study.question: Does replacing the single whole-user feedback background with smoothed recency/category/brand parent backgrounds improve the centered joint-moment combination beyond the incumbent and both imported sources, at fixed capacity and justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: If conditional feedback baselines differ across prefix-position recency and target category/brand match states, whole-user centering may conflate that baseline variation with event-content/feedback association. Inclusive parent rates, smoothed toward the same user rate, may give a more useful reference without deleting local evidence. A 2x2 recency-conditioning x relation-conditioning replacement tests those axes and their interaction. Prior failed leave-slot-out, conditional projection and late-context branches motivate a parameter-free background replacement; they remain counterevidence against broad claims of beneficial conditioning. Sparse-slot prevalence and conditional heterogeneity are presently unmeasured.

study.proposed_difference: Code slot index s=4*r+2*c+b. Let u_t be feedback successes divided by valid history length. For any parent P, q_P,t=(sum_{j in P} n_j f_jt+4*u_t)/(sum_{j in P}n_j+4). User arm uses u; recency arm q_{same r}; relation arm averages q_{same c} and q_{same b} over both recencies; crossed arm averages q_{same r,c} and q_{same r,b}. Match STATE includes zero/nonmatch states. Each parent includes its child; smoothing is descriptive, not an independent Bayesian prior. Compute all backgrounds in every arm and select only one by config. Use selected b_st in both g_st=alpha_s*f_st+(1-alpha_s)*b_st and subtract mean_projected_s*b_st after adding alpha_s*covariance. In exact arithmetic centered joint feature is alpha_s*(E[Wx*y|s]-E[Wx|s]*b_st). Raw fractions/counts and all trainable parameters stay fixed. Alpha=n/(n+4); pseudo-count4 and equal parent averaging are prospective, not tuned.

falsifiers: Crossed fails to beat the user calibration and incumbent under the same frozen protocol: no utility support for this tested crossed replacement; a failed implementation is not a universal rejection of conditional pooling.
Only recency or relation improves: no support for necessity of their combination; prefer the simpler supported arm and report the interaction.
A one-seed improvement disappears or reverses in paired repetitions: retain it as a selection-stage fluctuation, not repeated mechanism support.
User calibration differs materially, gradients/masking fail, sample/task identities differ, or contract changes would be required: comparison is invalid and no gain can be claimed.
Gains require materially higher measured compute, or lose their advantage against references at comparable measured cost: no efficiency claim; report the quality-cost trade-off.
alternative_explanations: Many validation-driven rounds can overfit this validation day; no test evidence or independent production transfer is available.
Subtracting another background may merely rescale/reparameterize features and improve single-pass optimization; success does not prove better estimation of a true conditional probability.
All parents overlap their children and each other. Raw fractions/counts expose much of this information already; redundancy or over-subtraction may erase useful cross-group signal.
Category/brand nonmatch states mix diverse entities, missing/OOV encoded IDs can coincide, and last16 positions are not16 units of elapsed time. Conditional strata may be inappropriate.
Pseudo-count4 and equal averaging are unvalidated design choices. Sparser conditional parents may add noise despite smoothing; no claim of optimal shrinkage.
Feedback maturity is inherited official_offline, and cart/fav/buy labels are user/category/brand matches within24h rather than advertisement-attributed conversions.

Small numerical/seed/optimizer interactions and batch-coupled Dice statistics can explain small changes; exact same-seed controls and unchanged capacity reduce but do not eliminate those explanations.
Recent conditional-projection failures and background-exclusion interaction may reflect readout/representation mismatch rather than absence of heterogeneous background rates.
